title: Krea AI Launches Krea 3 Beta Enabling 2K Image Edits Under 8 Seconds
summary:
Bounding box control and precise multi-turn edits are the primary features of a new image editing tool now available for public testing. The model, called Krea 3, can perform end-to-end 2K resolution edits in under 8 seconds and matches the quality of Nano Banana Pro or GPT Image 2.5, according to Krea AI. The model is also integrated into the fal platform, where it delivers edits in under 6 seconds.

Krea AI will issue a final release and publish further performance benchmarks next week. The company is currently providing early access to LoRAs and srefs for experimentation, while the fal implementation allows users to maintain subject consistency while changing settings or combining reference images with text instructions.
